C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

There were no Discussion Items.

D.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, spoke about reorganization of the Planning Commission; and
introduced Pablo Rubio as the new City Clerk.

Chairmember Winford requested that Reorganization of Members of the Planning Commission be
added on the next agenda.

E.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Vice Chairmember Rodriguez spoke regarding construction on Norwalk Blvd and 216th Street; and
inquired about the Casino exit on Carson St. and Seine Ave.

Kevin Nguyen, Associate Planner II, spoke.

Commissioner Roman spoke regarding the City of Hawaiian Gardens commercial and residential
investments bouncing back.

Commissioner Navarro thanked Kevin Nguyen for his great customer service to residents.

Chairmember Winford thanked Public Works for their fast graffiti removal, and asked if the development
on 216th Street (former City Hall Site) will have an architectural design that reflects other buildings that
were modified in recent years.

Vice Chairmember Rodriguez spoke regarding the requirement of no live entertainment for businesses.

Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, spoke.
